record.one_liner: Ecommerce helpdesk/customer-support platform with ticketing, live chat, and an AI support agent.
record.auth_notes: Private apps use Basic Auth with email + API key (usable directly from the API Reference for testing). Public/marketplace apps must use OAuth2, which is 'mandatory for public apps'.
record.access_notes: Private apps (API key/Basic Auth) require no approval — 'Private Apps ... These require no approval process — teams can go ahead and use it immediately after building.' Public apps go through a Developer Portal review before marketplace publishing, but that gate applies to marketplace distribution, not to building/using a private integration.
record.api_breadth_basis: Docs describe a full REST API reference with 'objects, and guides' covering tickets/customers/teams etc.; not confirmed to be 60+ endpoints but multiple resource families (tickets, customers, teams, macros) are referenced across the docs and MCP description.
record.blocker_notes: Private-app API key access is self-serve with no plan or approval gate found. A first-party MCP server (mcp.gorgias.com) is also available free on all Helpdesk plans, though some write operations remain gated during open beta.

evidence.quote: Use your email (username) and your API key
review it and let you know once it's approved and ready to be published
predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs
Gorgias MCP is included at no extra cost
